newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rheinmetall stake in auto supplier cleared.
newsitem.headline: Rheinmetall stake in auto supplier cleared.

text.p: The German Cartel Office said on Monday it would allow defence and engineering group Rheinmetall AG to take a majority position in auto component supplier Kolbenschmidt AG.
A spokeswoman said that plans by Rheinmetall, which already owns 25 percent minus one share of Kolbenschmidt, to take over a controlling stake raised no regulatory considerations.
Kolbenschmidt had welcomed the Rheinmetall offer as a friendly bid to stave off what it regarded as a hostile offer from Britain's T&N Plc.
T&N, which had launched its bid back in 1995, has appealed against the cartel office's rejection of its takeover offer.
